# Artifact Gateway v0.4.1

## 简体中文

Maven Hosted 直接上传单文件上限由 64 MiB 提高到 128 MiB，使较大的 JAR 可通过普通 Maven 仓库路径发布。上传仍使用有上限的临时缓存。该修复支持从 Nexus 导入 82 MiB 的历史 JAR。

本版还包含 0.4.0 后合入的仓库授权逐条管理和控制台改进：授权编辑不再替换整份授权列表，仓库与用户授权页面使用逐条写入；审计、加载与反馈状态、弹窗、表格和布局的显示更一致。完整变更见中英文 Changelog。本版相对 0.4.0 无新增数据库迁移；升级前仍应备份数据库和配置。

## English

Direct Maven Hosted uploads now accept files up to 128 MiB instead of 64 MiB, allowing larger JARs through the normal Maven repository path. The temporary upload spool remains bounded. This enables importing an 82 MiB historical JAR from Nexus.

This release also includes repository grant row operations and the Console improvements merged since 0.4.0. Grant editing now writes individual rows instead of replacing the entire set. Audit, loading and feedback states, dialogs, tables, and layout have been aligned. See the bilingual changelog for the full list. No new database migration is introduced relative to 0.4.0; back up the database and configuration before upgrading.
